rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the owner review of the holdout24 gate (0 hard defects of 43; the failed-tool turns stopped to confirm a phone number instead of acting; a minor injury lacked the medical pointer) and the prompt/scorer change made in response (act immediately on given contact details, state the number afterwards, medical pointer on every injury, no unexecuted offers to pass things on).
Not tuned against its results; any further prompt, engine or scorer change after scoring needs a new set.
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4).
